payload.title: Project Manager - Civil Construction
payload.description:
PROJECT MANAGER – CIVIL CONSTRUCTION
Seattle/Bellevue Area

If you’re looking for greater ownership, leadership responsibility, and the opportunity to drive complex projects from start to finish, this is your next step.

Gary Merlino Construction Co., Inc. (GMCC) is a locally owned, privately held general contractor specializing in heavy civil construction. With decades of proven success, GMCC has grown into one of the largest and most diversified contractors in the Puget Sound region while self-performing 85–90% of our work, giving our team unmatched hands-on experience.

As a recognized industry leader, GMCC offers employees the opportunity to lead high-impact, complex projects that shape the local community. You’ll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team where you’ll gain broad exposure across multiple civil disciplines and play a key role in delivering successful projects.

We are currently seeking a Project Manager to join our team in the Seattle/Bellevue area.
What You’ll Own

In this role, you will be responsible for overall project success, including:
 
  • Leading and collaborating with field teams to drive execution and solve problems in real time
  • Managing project team and overall project workflow
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with owners and contractors to ensure project alignment
  • Taking full ownership of project budgets, cost tracking, and financial performance
  • Leading forecasting and cost performance strategies to ensure profitability
  • Managing billing, subcontractor payments, and cost control
  • Overseeing and maintaining project schedules
  • Directing change orders and time-and-materials work
  • Ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards
Compensation & Benefits That Compete

GMCC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:
 
  • 401(k) with company participation
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Performance based bonus
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Life insurance and AD&D coverage
  • Long-term disability benefits
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSA)
  • Discounted gym memberships
If you’re looking to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and long-term career development—and are ready to take the next step into project leadership, we encourage you to apply.
Please submit your resume and cover letter to: resume@gmccinc.com
Or apply online at: https://gmcc.catsone.com/careers/

We are a federal contractor and an Equal Opportunity Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. We do not illegally discriminate in our employment decisions based on age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran status or pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by local or federal law.

We are also an Affirmative Action Employer and are committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals in our employment selection process.

payload.title: Certified Welder
payload.description:
Gary Merlino Construction Co., Inc is a privately held locally owned and operated general contractor specializing in heavy civil construction. Over the years GMCC has become one of the largest and most diversified contractors in the Puget Sound Region, self-performing approximately 85% - 90% of all projects awarded.
 
GMCC’s status as a leader in the Puget Sound construction industry gives our team an opportunity to work on a variety of unique projects in the area. You will be a member of a team that provides accelerated career growth through exposure to all civil disciplines.
 
We are currently seeking a CERTIFIED WELDER for our facility in Seattle.
 
Position Summary
We are looking for a FCAW WABO certified welder for our facility in Seattle with a current and valid driver's license. Ideal candidates have steel and aluminum fabrication experience, mechanical experience including electrical and troubleshooting, or with 5+ years of related work history. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Must have at least 3 years steel and aluminum welding experience or technical school completion with current WABO FCAW certificate.
  • Ability and desire to take on increasingly complex responsibilities.
  • Ability to read and follow engineer drawings and instructions, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to use wide variety of tools and equipment.
  • Ability to use overhead cranes and forklifts.
  • Proficient on a variety of steel and aluminum including various grades and thickness.
  • Mechanical experience including 12 volt wiring, hydraulic, and air.
  • Good attendance and attitude a must.
  • Legally allowed to work in the United States.

  
If you would like to work for a company that values honesty, loyalty and customer service while providing employees an opportunity to fulfill career goals, please submit your resume and cover letter to:  resume@gmccinc.com

payload.title: Project Coordinator - Civil Construction
payload.description:
PROJECT COORDINATOR – CIVIL CONSTRUCTION
Seattle/Bellevue Area

Start Your Career Where Projects Are Built - Not Just Managed

If you’re looking to launch a career in project management and want real-world experience, responsibility, and a clear path for growth, this is your opportunity.

The construction industry is one of the best environments to develop project management skills, combining planning, budgeting, scheduling, problem-solving, and team coordination in a fast-paced, high-impact setting. At GMCC, you won’t just learn theory, you’ll gain hands-on experience from day one.

Gary Merlino Construction Co., Inc. (GMCC) is a locally owned, privately held general contractor specializing in heavy civil construction. With decades of proven success, GMCC has grown into one of the largest and most diversified contractors in the Puget Sound region while self-performing 85–90% of our work, giving our team unmatched exposure and learning opportunities.

As a recognized industry leader, GMCC offers employees the opportunity to contribute to high-impact, complex projects that shape the local community. You’ll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team where you’ll gain broad exposure across multiple civil disciplines and benefit from accelerated career growth.

We are currently seeking a Project Coordinator to join our team in the Seattle/Bellevue area, with a clear growth path into a Project Engineer role.
What You’ll Learn & Support

In this role, you will build the foundation for a successful career in construction project management by:
 
  • Supporting field teams to keep projects moving and resolve issues quickly
  • Assisting with project budgets, cost tracking, and financial reporting
  • Helping process invoices, subcontractor payments, and owner billings
  • Aiding and learning from project team to ensure overall project workflow
  • Maintaining project scheduling and updates
  • Managing submittals, documentation, and project workflow
  • Facilitating change orders and time-and-materials work
Career Growth Path

This role is designed as a launching point into construction project management. You’ll gain the experience, mentorship, and exposure needed to grow into a Project Engineer role and beyond.
What We’re Looking For

We’re not just looking for experience; we’re looking for drive, potential, and mindset to grow.
 
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills
  • Strong self-motivation and work ethic
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment
  • Solid problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Effective time management and organizational skills
  • Creativity and initiative in approaching challenges
  • Ability to navigate and support conflict resolution
Why Start Here?

Where you begin your career matters, and this is where you’ll build skills that will set you apart and gain:
 
  • Hands-on exposure to both field operations and office management
  • Opportunity to work on diverse, large-scale civil projects
  • A clear pathway to becoming a Project Engineer and beyond
  • Mentorship from experienced industry professionals
  • Accelerated career growth at a company that self-performs most if its work
Compensation & Benefits That Compete

GMCC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:
 
  • 401(k) with company participation
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Performance based bonus
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Life insurance and AD&D coverage
  • Long-term disability benefits
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSA)
  • Discounted gym memberships
Ready to start building your future?

Please submit your resume and cover letter to: resume@gmccinc.com
Or apply online at: https://gmcc.catsone.com/careers/
